title: The Best Zigbee Sprinkler and Hose Timers
subtitle: Zigbee water timers for Home Assistant and other Zigbee hubs, ranked.
intro: Zigbee hose timers are a small category. We scored the ones on Amazon on rating, review volume, and features: zones, flow metering, and brass inlets.

buyers_guide.a: A hose timer screws onto an outdoor faucet to water gardens, drip lines, and hose sprinklers. An in-ground controller replaces the box that runs a buried sprinkler system.

buyers_guide.q: Why do some need a gateway?
buyers_guide.a: The timer at the faucet runs on batteries and uses Bluetooth or a low-power radio. A plug-in gateway inside connects it to Wi-Fi so you can control it away from home.
Bring timers inside before the first hard freeze. Water left inside can crack the valve.
